title: Strategic Classification Has a Missing Lever: Audit Risk
abstract: arXiv:2609.22534v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Strategic classification studies how a decision maker should choose a classifier when the agents being classified can adjust their features in response to it. In existing models, the classifier is the only instrument available to the decision maker, and therefore a feature that is predictive but easy to fake can only be down-weighted or discarded. However, in many settings the decision maker can also verify: lenders verify income, admissions offices check documents, and tax authorities audit returns. In this paper, we propose a model of strategic classification in which the firm jointly designs a linear classifier and an \emph{audit profile}, which assigns to each fakeable feature a probability of detection and a penalty when caught. We show that under linear costs, the classifier affects the audit problem only through the distribution of gaming rents it induces, so that the joint design problem decomposes into the choice of a score ru

translated_title: 策略性分类缺失的一个杠杆：审计风险
translated_abstract: 策略性分类研究的是当被分类的个体能够根据分类器调整自身特征时，决策者应如何选择分类器。在现有模型中，分类器是决策者唯一可用的工具，因此一个具有预测性但容易被伪造的特征只能被降权或直接丢弃。然而，在许多现实场景中，决策者还可以进行核实：贷款机构核实收入、招生办公室查验文件、税务机关审计纳税申报。在本文中，我们提出了一个策略性分类模型，其中企业联合设计一个线性分类器和一个审计配置，该配置为每个可伪造特征分配一个被查出的概率以及被抓到时的惩罚。我们证明，在线性成本下，分类器仅通过其所引发的博弈租金分布来影响审计问题，从而使联合设计问题可以分解为对评分规则的选择……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在策略性分类中引入审计机制（为可伪造特征设定查处概率与惩罚），证明分类器与审计配置的联合设计问题可以分解，从而为决策者提供了除调整分类器之外的新工具——审计风险。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces audit risk into strategic classification by jointly designing a linear classifier and an audit profile (detection probabilities and penalties for fakeable features), showing that the joint design problem decomposes and giving decision makers a new lever beyond classifier tuning.
